payload.body: Measured baseline for whole-journal reads, Bun 1.2.4 / macOS arm64, 2026-08-09: the live store held 1,267 events across 635 active+archive segments totalling 504,127 bytes, with 21 decision resolutions; a cold 'nahel progress' scan took roughly 0.15s. That is why Decision Digest v1 shipped a whole-store reread as an accepted tradeoff rather than an index — the measured cost did not justify one. Re-measure before treating large-history ergonomics (roadmap node 2p91x87w) as urgent.
